raw.query: SELECT cl.run_id, cl.gpu_hours, cl.p99_ttft_ms, cl.p99_itl_ms, w.span_s, (4.0 * w.span_s / 3600.0) AS denominator_gpu_hours, (cl.gpu_hours / (4.0 * w.span_s / 3600.0)) AS cost_ratio FROM provenance.llm_run_summary cl CROSS JOIN provenance.windows w WHERE cl.run_id = 'planner:week_fc_p90' AND w.window_name = 'aggregate';
raw.claimed: 518.6 H100 GPU-hours vs static 537.4 (0.965x) at TTFT p99 651 ms and ITL p99 6.4 ms
raw.evidence: Exact match of numerator (518.61 GPU-h), TTFT p99 (651.1 ms), and ITL p99 (6.4 ms) in llm_run_summary; the 537.4 GPU-h baseline is the analytical cost of a 4-GPU static TP2x2 fleet over the 483,659.8s aggregate window (518.61 / 537.40 = 0.9650x).
raw.fix: Update the claim's expected backing metadata to reference llm_run_summary and windows, as v_cost_ratio only contains encoder-pool data by design.
